reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment For my sick cat for the next day. Which was an in room Appointment when I scheduled it. I just got a phone call that it was not actually available? So I’m not sure . They said software issue but something was odd about it. They probably didn’t want to do a free exam . Anyway on the site it says that they have tons of appointments so if you’re planning on booking, maybe don’t Because there’s a chance it’s not actually available. Something about the whole thing seems really off putting . Like they only want you to drop off your pet and suddenly they’re in room appointments aren’t actually available? I don’t know to me that seems odd… My sister had told me in advance that this place wasn’t The best experience she ever had so I should’ve Listened.

Hi Nicole - our aim is to provide a positive experience to everyone coming to our hospitals. We understand you were not satisfied and would like to follow up on your experience with us. Please reach out to our Client Advocate Team at BanfieldCares@banfield.com at your convenience so we can try to address your concerns.

If I could give Banfield on Elston in Chicago zero stars, I honestly would.

I brought my dog in to be examined, and thankfully the doctor and the nurse who assisted her were wonderful. The doctor was sweet, knowledgeable, professional, and took the time to help me. The nurse was also very kind and helpful. I have absolutely nothing negative to say about them.

However, the front desk experience was completely unacceptable.

The young woman working at the front desk was extremely rude, had a horrible attitude, and spoke to me in a way that was completely unprofessional. She was also on her cell phone while dealing with customers, which is unacceptable in any professional workplace. Her attitude was so bad that it completely changed my experience at the hospital.

While checking out and trying to make another appointment, I felt like I was being treated as if I was bothering her. There was no reason for the disrespectful attitude or the way she spoke to me.

Management seriously needs to address this. If an employee consistently treats customers this way, something needs to be done. Customer service matters. People are bringing their pets to you because they trust you with animals they love.

The doctor and nurse were great, but unfortunately, one person’s terrible customer service can make a customer decide never to return. I have plenty of other animal hospitals in Chicago I can take my dog to, and I expect to receive both good veterinary care and basic respect.

Banfield management needs to check what is happening at that front desk because this type of behavior should not be tolerated.

I really don't recommend this hospital for any animals. They supposedly did a lot of tests on my dog, but it was all a lie. They offer all kinds of insurance, but it's all a scam. Because of them, and especially the doctor, my dog ​​died. I had to take her to another pet hospital for an emergency, and they diagnosed her with pneumonia, and she died right then and there. That's why I don't recommend this hospital; it's better to take your pet somewhere else.
Monthly payment does not cover anything other than a regular visit.
Max and papi were in this place and they are the worst hospital. In this place the pets life isn’t matter. And the price are so expensive. And the doctor are the worst.

I was a Banfield Optimum Wellness Plan member since 2019. My dog and I live too much of the first six years of her life on the road and we utilized many different Banfield locations. This one is one of the worst, and caused me to leave Banfield and end my Wellness Plan permanently. The support staff are extremely impersonal, your animal never actually sees a vet they only see technicians, the prices are astronomical, they spring prices on you at the last second to try to scare you into accepting overpriced procedures, and after a year of working with this particular Banfield, they still couldn't even get my dog's name right. This tells me they didn't really care at all, and we're just going through the motions. Avoid this place like the plague.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This was my first time taking my cat, Yodie, to the vet, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The entire staff was welcoming, kind, and professional from the moment we walked in. They took great care of Yodie while he received his vaccinations, including his rabies shot, and explained everything clearly throughout the visit.

One thing that really stood out to me was how calm and relaxed Yodie was when they brought him back to us. That gave me a lot of confidence that he was treated with patience and compassion while he was in their care.

Thank you to everyone at Banfield Pet Hospital for making our first visit such a positive one. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary team!
They have reasonable prices compared to other vets. I appreciate that they're very upfront with pricing and quick to suggest alternatives if you indicate any hesitation with the cost.
I feel so happy, they treat my Scooby Doo wonderfully, I feel so content
Everyone was very caring and attentive. Everything was explained in great detail. Vet called to explain how the exam went.
I love it they do take care of midnight very well.

Absolutely ridiculous. They don't answer the phone, don't call you back when you leave a message, encourage you to use their online scheduler, and then dont honor the appointment. I drove 30min in traffic and they call 2 min before appointment time to say the online schedule is 'different from their in office schedule'. Waste of time. Also ridiculous that vets are moving away from in-room appointments. Im not crating my sick dog for who knows how long.

We had the opportunity to learn about your situation and read about your frustrations with our service. If you would like to discuss this matter further, we would like to offer you the opportunity to do so and escalate your concerns. To ensure we can address any concerns, please contact us at your convenience.
Jasper 🐕 my dog 🐕 ❤️ was well taken care of 💯 Ty
Terrible customer service.

I always have a wonderful experience at this hospital. The assistants, doctors and front desk staff are ALL PHENOMENAL! I want to give an extra shout out to Mary at the reception desk. She ALWAYS GOES ABOVE & BEYOND to help the customers. She went out of her way to assist me in a very stressful time and is continuing to assist me by exploring all available options for the care of my dog Abbey. Having Mary being the "front person" for your business is an EXTREMELY VALUABLE ASSET to this hospital. The GENUINE CARE & ATTENTION she gives is TOP NOTCH! She is a TRUE GEM! Thankyou Mary for ALL your efforts, expertise & GENUINE CONCERN for your customers and our beloved pets! Give this woman a bonus & raise PLEASE!
Shawnise - We're so glad you had a great experience! We’ll make sure to pass this on to our Chicago location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet's needs.
Hi Brittany - Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …
The staff and Dr. Wilson are very kind and caring.

Always a great experience at Banfield Lincoln Park! Good Boy Ozz The Distinguished Gentleman, got the works and did not seem to have problems after. I tell all my friends with pets go to Banfield. Service is excellent pricing reasonable
In case of an emergency they don't help; you have to make an appointment to have your pet checked.

A bit of scheduling issues for office visit versus drop off visit, but the drop off visit ended up being convenient for us and we were still seen by a vet tech. The offered solutions without pushing extra products and treatments. The vet was very kind and helpful when she called. Also fast and flexible with medication pick up.
You've got us purring with your rating! 🐱 Thank you for choosing Banfield. …

Absolute worst. Have been paying for wellness plan for 15 years. When I finally needed them, they put me on hold for 25 minutes and hung up eventually (the man answering the phone the morning of 2/4/26). I called the Skokie location and they were going excellent.

Do not go to this location if possible. The doctor on staff, Nia Powell, was very rude and dismissive when I was presenting a dog with an injury. I work at the adjacent business that this clinic resides in and was trying to ensure that policy was being followed. Banfield has a history of being reluctant to provide medical attention and the doctors that cycle in on staff are very hesitant to dispense medication, quality care and general empathy for animals brought in, particularly small animals and exotics. This doctor in question was very bothered that I was asking them to perform their duties at a veterinary clinic that has a pet store attached to and are business partners with.

My dog had liver problem but every time Dr. never noticed or mention me about this that I paid for the plan and blood work. They always say oh ya! your dog is fine kidneys disease is fine everything is good until I went to another location that I found out my dog’s liver is high. Then today I really upset because Dr.Powell called and talked to me about my dog health and ready to go home. When I get there I have been waiting like 45 minutes. After I got my dog I just have only one question that the staff just ask the Dr. but they both has gone for 15-20 minutes then I left. Then Dr.Powell called me to let me know that I know about my dog health and Dr. kind like rush, she talk to me really fast, no listen any question and hang me up literally fast. Like she does not care. I knew you are pretty busy. I knew you have another dog to take care but you guys even technician did not solve my question for this time. I pay for the plan and I paid for extra cost. I did not get everything free and this is my pet health and my pet life. Honestly Dr. Miller is the best for me!

Update!!!

My dog passed away. Because she had cancer.

Everyone take their pet to the vet for check up their health even my dog too. My dog was collapse so many time. On August I took her to specialist at blue-pearl where she had record about heart murmur and doctor over there said her heart was stable her lungs still clear.

Then next day I came to banfield and met dr.Wilson, I have no idea how she checked up my dog. She always said my dog looked good even though when she did blood work and my dog had liver so high she still said my dog was ok.

I talked with dr.Wilson and she said she did not had any idea what was going on with my dog just only heart murmur to be the reason of my dog health. Nobody never recommended me to do anything. No guideline to x-ray or whatever.

Everyone comes to see doctor that means they need recommendation, guideline,  and adviser for everything for their love.

I think Dr. Wilson and another dr. here are truly have not knowledge about the pet. I felt they are not emphasize about our pet.

Please take your love to the other clinic or other pet hospital not here.

Dr Stacy Wilson, the vet techs, and desk staff are all AMAZING! Very patient, explain everything thoroughly, with the utmost professionalism. The facilities are clean, parking is free and handy.

Wished I had been seeing Dr Wilson for so much longer! They do USDA certificates for international travel and explained all steps very helpfully.

Highly recommend!
abby is one of the most thorough and kindest vet techs we’ve had!

Annual check-up. Waited an hour and 15 minutes for the vet to walk and examine my dog for less than 2 minutes. The vet was rushing and didn’t acknowledge the wait or say hello. I could sum up everything up to this point. The vet just wasn’t professional.
They take great care of my two dogs Nugget and Henry
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

This is the worst Banfield I’ve ever experienced. Others are wonderful- full of people who love and care for your pet as your own.  This one is full of sassy people who hang up the phone on you.

My dog has been here 3 times in the past 10 days. I have spent hundreds of dollars and have not ONCE had a doctor call me and tell me what is going on.

They didn’t call in my dogs prescription medicine to the pharmacy “because we were on hold for a really long time”. They did not think to call me and tell me that, nor did they try to call the pharmacy back and try again.

My dog NEEDS her prescription and these sassy desk girls claim it’s not their job and refuse to help.

I’ve been a Banfield customer for all of the 11 years my dog has been alive, and never once had an experience even remotely close to as awful as this. If you care about your pet, don’t bring them here.

EDIT: there was ONE very sweet employee (vet tech) who helped me and got me exactly what I needed. Ironically her colleague who said it was “impossible” stood by in silence. Thank you to the sweet girl that helped !
We're thrilled that you and your pet had a positive experience with us. Thanks for sharing your review!

Christina’s behavior during the interaction was unprofessional and lacked empathy. Her tone and manner were discourteous and not reflective of the level of service expected from a customer-facing representative.

I am so fed up with Banfield and their crap. Never have appointments, they have to be drop off to they can squeeze more pets in and then keep them in cages all day. They were amazing in Phoenix but just terrible here in Chicago. After 4 years cancelled my plan and will take my pets care elsewhere.

Dont sign up with them if you care for your pet.
I have always had positive experience at Lincoln Park Banfield

My 3 year old French bulldog went in for a teeth cleaning, when I picked him up he was in terrible pain panting non stop thru the entire evening the next morning he could no longer walk!!!! It’s been 3 years and he still cannot walk! Banfield said they believe it was a pre existing condition! I think he was dropped which may have caused spinal injury. I was told there are not cameras in any room “So I Guess We’ll Never No”! They charged me the next day for pain meds and told me to go to an emergency vet. The day I brought him in the vet on duty was in charge of 32 pets????? I had to fight with them to cancel my pet plan after being with them for over 11 years with previous pets! They have never reached out in any way! $11,000 later he still does not walk does not have IDVV and is in diapers!!!! Stay as far away as possible!!!!
We love Dr.Nas she saved our pet
Banfield had been wonderful for my dog Rocky Vega. They cured him of his itchy ears and he is in overall good health. They are kind and professional! Best doctors for my Rocky!
Wow, we're wagging our tails at your rating! Your positive experience means the world to us.

There's different vets each and everytime I take my cat in so there's no proper continuity of care, last vet never bothered to call me back to discuss my cat's lab results and treatment plan despite me leaving a message - or maybe the receptionist did not give my message also, who knows, but I'm not satisfied with the quality of care provided, when my cat had an emergency last year they couldn't even fit her in. I plan to switch vets.

I’m very disappointed with how my senior dog and I were treated during this recent visit. She’s 16, with severe anxiety and arthritis, and I was told I couldn’t stay with her;something I’ve always been allowed to do in previous visits. After 30 minutes, I was finally told I could stay.  a staff member even admitted, “Oh yeah, she has anxiety, she shouldn’t stay alone.” So why deny me the chance to comfort her?

This clinic has made serious mistakes in the past. Which has lead up to us having to staying with her.  One year, they prescribed medication that a pharmacist later told us, it could have killed my dog if she had taken it. Another time, they moved her to their boarding area without my consent, falsely claiming I didn’t show up to pick her up. Mind you I had called and they stated she wasn’t ready, called again before they close and they said “your dog isn’t here she’s been ready to get picked up”

The vet initially refused an in-room exam, claiming my dog “bites,” despite her never having bitten anyone. After noticing how upset I was becoming they finally agreed to do the exam with me in the room. They muzzled her, but when she began panting, they removed it and said, “Oh, so she can breathe again.” This was careless and upsetting.

All they did was check her heart rate, gave me some paperwork about arthritis medications, and mentioned a $400 shot. No thorough exam or meaningful discussion just a charge.

To make matters worse, the front desk was the one who told me I couldn’t stay, that “in room visits aren’t allowed in the morning, they’re allowed at noon”, please show me where that is written because I couldn’t find it online. Later on after I was checking out she offered a white family to stay with their dog during their visit shortly after. I’m Latina, and this felt like discrimination, especially during times like this.

For a while, things seemed to improve, but then they messed up again showing a pattern of inconsistency and carelessness. We will not be returning. We hoped there had finally been a change, but once again, Banfield proved us wrong.

Took my cat here for a comprehensive inspection which I pay monthly for. I left a note about an incident he had I was curious considering he's a kitten and they never returned my call I left multiple voicemails. They had me drop off my cat he sat 4 hours in a kennel no inspection no trim nothing. Then they told me to reschedule I booked my appointment on the app where it said it for the inspection. There's no way im ever taking ant animal here they dont care won't return or call and have horrible service
Do yourself a favor go to another banfield because this is the worst experience I've ever had for people who claimed to care
I love Banfield. They are amazing knowing your babies are safe thank you Banfield.

If I could give this 0 stars I would!!! I  knew there was something wrong with my dog so I brought him in. They sent my sick dog home 15 minutes after I dropped him off and swore “there was nothing wrong” he died 4 days later. My baby deserved better than what they did to him. RUN AWAY !!!DO NOT GO TO BANFIELD!!! This is the worst vet in Chicago!

This facility does not even deserve one single star. They are so inconsiderate with their constant appointment cancellations and then make it impossible to reschedule due to them not answering the phone or having to wait extended months to reschedule with them. I’m so glad I ended up cancelling my plan with them! Something less I have to stress about.
If I can give a 0 I would conny is very rude and doesn’t rely the messages
Wow, we're wagging our tails at your rating! Your positive experience means the world to us.
Honestly, great kind people. However to book an appointment takes forever. And the appointment is not until weeks in advance.
Never go to a banfield….any of them 🥲 …

Been a loyal member for 20 plus years,  though the doctors change the service has not. Had one issue with a visiting doctor in which one of my pets died but I'm still here.  Thank you for keeping my babies healthy.

By far the worst vet experience I’ve ever had. Took my cat in for a teeth cleaning which they couldn’t do because the anesthesia machine wasn’t working. Only found out 6 hours after drop off because we called them to ask how it went and when we could pick up. The staff left my cat trapped in his carrier the entire day forcing him to pee and poop in his carrier and then sit in it until I could come get him. Complete and utter disregard for my cat’s health and cleanliness. Staff were rude and dismissive about it. If I could give this place negative stars, I would. If you cherish your pets or expect basic human decency from the people who are supposed to be taking care of them, do not bring them to this Banfield location.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾  …

This service is terrible. Every time I need something for my two puppies, the available appointments are only one or two months away. When I check the premium chat for assistance with an illness, they tell me to make an appointment for the following month if the allergy persists. It's truly awful. Today I took my dog ​​because I thought she was pregnant. My roommate left them alone while she was in heat, and her nipples were swollen. I took her to the vet on the 30th day of the supposed pregnancy. They didn't even look at her or examine her; they just told me to come back in two weeks. Today was 45 days, and to my surprise, she wasn't pregnant. But they charged me $342 for one x-ray to check if she was pregnant. They didn't even examine her before charging me. It's outrageous. I hope I never have to go back to this place. They just want to rip you off. Maybe they charged me so much because they're French Bulldogs, but $342 for something that took less than five minutes is excessive.
The employees was very polite and treated my 7 week old puppy with so much love
